newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU says would vet Air France deal if confirmed.
newsitem.headline: EU says would vet Air France deal if confirmed.

text.p: Air France's planned hook up with two major U.S. carriers, Delta Air Lines and Continental, would come under European Commission scrutiny if the deal goes ahead, a spokeswoman told Reuters on Wednesday.
"We have no formal comment to make until we know what's going on," the spokeswoman said.
"That being said, if the deal does go ahead it would be subject to all the usual checks," she added.
The French state airline said on Wednesday it had signed separate letters of intent for cooperation with Delta and Continental after a lengthy search for a U.S. partner.

The EU executive's competition officials routinely vet joint-ventures or mergers involving EU carriers. Their transport colleagues recently began a probe into the competition effects of transatlantic tie-ups such as the one planned between British Airways and AMR Corp's American Airlines.
Including Wednesday's announced deal in the alliances probe would require the Commission to open a fresh, albeit directly linked, investigtation.
